item: ARCH-32 (PM delivery check 2026-10-07): enforce autonomously and forever the seven principles of the research institution
rule: Every principle names the organs that enforce it TODAY. Each organ is verified against the tree on every pass (a leg must be on the hourly cycle, a fence must be wired into the law gate, a task must be in the box manifest, a code organ must still carry its token). A principle whose organs all fail to resolve is UNENFORCED and fails scripts/check_principles.py; an organ that stops resolving is a MISSING_ORGAN finding and fails it too. Edit this file to add organs; removing one needs the organ itself to be gone or replaced, and the fence says which.

organ_kinds.fence: scripts/<name> exists and is named in scripts/run_law_gate.py
organ_kinds.task: desks/mt5/ops/box_tasks.manifest carries TASK name="<name>" and the script it runs exists

principles.text: No sacred strategy, model, source or geography: everything live has a retirement path, and nothing is hard-coded as exempt from retirement or from the gauntlet.

organs.name: promoter
organs.role: automatic retirement of LIVE sleeves (retire_banned, retire_unrunnable, gold window retirement)
retirement path for every promoted row

organs.token: THE GOLD BOOK DECAYS LIKE EVERYTHING ELSE
organs.role: the gold book is retirable; v2..v4 aliases fold into the canonical window

organs.name: decay_monitor
organs.role: FADE/RETIRE of live sleeves on their own live ledger

organs.name: probation
organs.role: re-judges admitted sleeves

organs.name: certificate_truth
organs.role: residue certificates and banned families retired from every derived store

organs.name: experimental_budget
organs.role: principal overrides kept in their own ledger, never silently sacred

organs.name: graveyard_resurrection
organs.role: no sacred death either: the dead are re-tested

organs.name: check_no_retirement_on_absence.py
organs.role: retirement only on evidence

organs.name: check_strategy_breadth.py
organs.role: never limited to one family (L1.32)

organs.name: check_regional_parity.py
organs.role: no region absent or privileged
ARCH-32 lint: no module-level exemption constant in the research trees

principles.text: Structural change triggers relearning: a regime-break or decay detector exists and a refit or re-judge is wired to it.

organs.name: MT5-ShiftWatch
organs.role: distribution-shift detector (KS/variance ratio + Page CUSUM) over every LIVE symbol -> reports/DIST_SHIFT.json

organs.name: decay_monitor
organs.role: live decay detector -> data/decay_live.json

organs.name: regime_monitor
organs.role: regime state -> data/regime_state.json

organs.name: regime_hierarchy
organs.role: hourly regime refit -> reports/REGIME_HIERARCHY.json
ARCH-32 wire: each shift/decay trigger queues a `recertify` task for the validation role

organs.name: queue_cycle
organs.role: runs the structural_change producer every hour

organs.name: recertify_canon
organs.role: claims `recertify` tasks and re-runs the certificate gates

organs.name: swap_rejudge
organs.role: re-prices every certificate when the cost model changes

principles.text: Cash is an allocation: the allocator scores holding capital back against every sleeve rather than being handed full investment.

organs.name: pf_allocator
organs.role: the optimiser; publishes heat.free_optimum (the cash-admissible optimum) beside the resolved book
sum(h) <= cap: the book may hold back when nothing is worth betting on
retained capital priced as an option, compared with the marginal sleeve

organs.name: check_allocator_liveness.py
organs.role: the allocator ran, proved and published

organs.name: check_growth_governance.py
organs.role: two-sided: cash wins only on evidence, never by a rule

principles.text: Research never stops: the mining and judge legs run every cycle and the backlog drains at a non-zero rate.
Validation never relaxes: gate thresholds and coverage floors only ratchet tighter, checked against git history and the floor files.

organs.name: check_immutable_evaluator.py
organs.role: gate_spec.yaml and the judging code are hash-sealed

organs.name: null_lab
organs.role: each family's own gates measured on data with no edge

organs.name: placebo_audit
organs.role: the gates graded against planted defects
ARCH-32: every gate_spec bound compared with its strictest value in git history

principles.text: Execution teaches research: realized fills and P&L reach a research consumer that changes what is searched or how it is priced.
The ontology stays open: the family and feature registries accept new entries and have grown recently.
